♯ FW !!! TIGER CANINES👀👀 ♯ Tigers possess 30 highly specialized teeth designed exclusively for a predatory lifestyle. Their upper jaw holds 16 teeth, while the lower jaw contains 14, only moving vertically without any side-to-side grinding. Dominating their mouth are the canine teeth, which grow between 2.5 and 4 inches (6.4 to 10 cm) long, making them the largest of any living cat species. These massive fangs are embedded with pressure-sensitive nerves that allow the tiger to feel exactly where to place a lethal bite to sever a victim's spinal cord or windpipe. A wide gap called a diastema separates these front weapons from the sharp, scissor-like carnassial teeth at the back, which shear meat into swallowable chunks without chewing. While born completely toothless, tigers quickly develop temporary milk teeth before their permanent adult set grows in to deliver an incredible bite force of up to 1,100 PSI ⌣  #tiger #canines #teeth #pantheriatigris #fyp
